EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat ends.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description:
Planting is Seedbed's handling rule: the card is removed from the current combat before entering your hand, and you gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold].
Planting does not count as playing, discarding, or [gold]Exhausting[/gold]. It does not trigger those synergies, and Seedbed does not permanently delete Curses.
· [gold]Temporary Status/Curse[/gold]: Removed from combat and disappears afterwards.
· [gold]Blight Sprout[/gold]: Handled for this combat; it does not enter hand, does not grow, and adds no [gold]Rootblight I[/gold] after combat.
· [gold]Rootblight[/gold]: Its combat-end check is frozen. It is not played, cleansed, improved, worsened, or split, and remains in the master deck at the same stage after combat.
Its strength is the package: immediate Block, one fewer pollution draw this combat, and a [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] that can later Exhaust for Block.
